scenarios.name: Discard a pending edit from an open command category list

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel without applying
the user opens the command category list and presses Down
Macros has keyboard focus in the open category list
the user presses Escape
the category list and customization dialog close
no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
the user reopens customization from the Tools ribbon
the category shows All Commands
the Part Tools custom panel list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the target has no pending-change marker
the user clicks Close
the dialog closes
the user clicks Done in the Measure panel
the Measure panel closes
the user reopens ribbon customization
the user removes Measure from the custom panel and clicks OK
the User Commands panel is no longer visible
the original Measure command remains visible
